# Authoring templates

These are reusable editorial templates, not completed lessons or projects. Copy the relevant directory, replace the bracketed authoring prompts, then complete the quality gate. Keep the worked notebook skeleton executable while replacing it with topic-specific teaching.

- [Chapter README](chapter/README.md)
- [Theory structure](chapter/theory/concepts.md)
- [Notebook template](notebook-template.ipynb)
- [Project template](project/README.md)
- [Experiment journal](experiment-log.md)
- [Completion checklist](../chapter-completion-checklist.md)

For a new chapter create `README.md`, `theory/`, `notebooks/`, `src/`, `exercises/`, `mini-project/` and `assets/`. Write a few focused notebooks rather than a long all-in-one tutorial. The template's bracketed text is intentionally unfinished authoring guidance; do not mark it complete or present it as delivered curriculum.
